name: sinky-todo-qa
description: Smart To-Do List - QA Test Suite & CI/CD

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:backend && npm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:backend && npm run type-check:frontend && npm run type-check:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:e2e
scripts.lint:backend: cd app/backend && npm run lint || true
scripts.lint:frontend: cd app/frontend && npm run lint || true
scripts.lint:e2e: cd e2e && npm run lint || true
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend && npm run format:e2e
scripts.format:backend: cd app/backend && npm run format || true
scripts.format:frontend: cd app/frontend && npm run format || true
scripts.format:e2e: cd e2e && npm run format || true
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.ci: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.pre-commit: npm run type-check:e2e && npm run test:api

author: QA Engineer - Sinky
